commands.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
brief = Path('brief.txt').read_text()
invite = Path('invite.md').read_text()
checklist = Path('checklist.md').read_text()
print('BRIEF\\n' + brief)
for name, content in [('invite.md', invite), ('checklist.md', checklist)]:
    print(name + '\\n' + content)
    for fact in ['Saved Filters Lab', 'existing product users', 'Friday', '14:00 UTC', 'local preview room', 'one saved search']:
        assert fact in content, (name, fact)
    assert 'draft' in content.lower() and 'do not send' in content.lower()
words = len(invite.split())
assert words < 100, words
assert len(re.findall(r'"'^- '"\\[ \\] ', checklist, re.M)) == 3
print(f'PASS: invitation {words} words; exactly 3 organiser checkboxes; both files contain all brief facts and draft-only restrictions.')
PY"
